services.heading:
Discover What I Offer
For Your Children

at-home-care.title: At Home Care
at-home-care.description: Personalized childcare in the comfort of your home. I provide a safe, engaging, and nurturing environment tailored to your child's routine.

hotel-vacation.title: Hotel & Vacation Babysitting
hotel-vacation.description: Trusted babysitting while you enjoy your vacation or a night out. I bring age-appropriate activities and ensure your little ones feel safe and entertained.

special-needs.title: Special Needs Support
special-needs.description: Compassionate care tailored to children with autism and other developmental needs, incorporating visual supports and sensory-friendly activities.
idealFor: Children with autism or developmental needs

family-outing.title: Family Outing Support
family-outing.description: Extra hands and heart while you're out and about. I accompany families during outings to provide calm, professional assistance.

activities.label: Activities
activities.heading: Here's What's Included During Babysitting Time:

reading-time.title: Reading Time
reading-time.description: We explore books together to build language skills, spark imagination, and create calm moments.

arts-crafts.title: Arts & Crafts
arts-crafts.description: Creative time using age-appropriate materials to support fine motor skills and self-expression.

sensory-playtime.title: Sensory & Playtime
sensory-playtime.description: Structured and free play using toys, music, sensory bins, or imaginative games to support learning.

meal-support.title: Meal & Snack Support
meal-support.description: I help with feeding routines, encourage independence, and ensure safe, clean, and enjoyable mealtimes.

routines-transitions.title: Routines & Transitions
routines-transitions.description: Support with daily routines such as hand washing, diapering, clean-up, naptime, or bedtime.

outdoor-play.title: Outdoor Play
outdoor-play.description: Time outside in fresh air for movement, exploration, and physical activity—when space and weather allow.

emotional-support.title: Emotional Support
emotional-support.description: Gentle guidance to help children feel safe, regulated, and confident during activities and transitions.

safety-supervision.title: Safety & Supervision
safety-supervision.description: I prioritize your child's well-being at all times with close supervision, clear boundaries, and safe environments.

about.label: About Me
about.heading:
Experienced babysitter
providing quality childcare.
about.bio1: Hi! I'm Amanda, with 8+ years of experience caring for children in homes and hotels across Puerto Rico.
about.bio2: Bachelor's in Speech Therapy, Master's in Special Education & Autism, and Master's in Psychological Counseling.
about.bio3: I specialize in toddlers & preschoolers with fun, creative approaches, always with love, patience & structure!
